'''Selig Kenjenn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was one of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]] sent to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Kenjenn wielded two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and was not listed among the casualties.

==Behind the scenes==
Kenjenn did not appear in the movie [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], or any [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] stories surrounding the Battle of Geonosis. He is a creation of [[Hasbro]], released in a battle pack in [[2013]] with fellow Jedi [[Que-Mars Redath-Gom/Legends|Que-Mars Redath]] and [[Khaat Qiyn/Legends|Khaat Qiyn]], as well as [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone captain]] [[Deviss/Legends|Deviss]].

[[File:Lelandcheejedi.jpg|thumb|left|Kenjenn and two other Jedi face Imperial stormtroopers]]
In promotional art for Kenjenn (picture top left), he is seen with 2 Jedi, tie fighters flying in the background, a Star Destroyer also visible, and stormtrooper blasters can be seen, implying he survived the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Kenjenn's likeness was based on [[Leland Chee]], the Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]]. Chee himself [https://www.facebook.com/pages/Keeper-of-the-Holocron/201820953172172?ref=stream&hc_location=stream&filter=2 established on his Facebook page] that Kenjenn is the same character as a Jedi with Chee's likeness from an earlier, unofficial illustration of Chee as a Jedi by [[Joe Corroney]].
